info.name: Sign up with ID
Înregistrare cu CI
info.summary: Self-registration from a phone with a photo of the identity card and a verified e-mail address
Înregistrare de pe telefon, cu poza cărții de identitate și adresă de e-mail verificată
info.description:
Visitors register themselves from their phone: they photograph their Romanian identity card, the server reads the name and given names from it (Tesseract OCR, MRZ and check-digit validated CNP), and they add an e-mail address, a phone number and a password.
Only the e-mail address is verified, with a six digit code and a confirmation link. The name taken from the identity card, the e-mail address and the phone number cannot be changed afterwards.
The picture of the identity card is never stored: it is read in memory and discarded. The personal number (CNP) is not stored either — only a salted hash of it, so the same card cannot be used twice.
The card reader is a PHP port of the parser in the NecMat app (github.com/CristianCasapu/necmat).
info.author: Cristian Casapu
